<template>
  <el-dialog title="添加容器" v-model="dialogVisible" width="500px">
    <el-form :model="container" ref="containerForm" label-width="80px" class="container-form">
      <el-form-item label="容器名称" :rules="[{ required: true, message: '请输入容器名称', trigger: 'blur' }]">
        <el-input v-model="container.name" placeholder="请输入容器名称"></el-input>
      </el-form-item>

      <el-form-item label="容器镜像" :rules="[{ required: true, message: '请输入镜像名称', trigger: 'blur' }]">
        <el-input v-model="container.image" placeholder="请输入镜像名称"></el-input>
      </el-form-item>

      <el-form-item label="容器网络" :rules="[{ required: false, message: '请选择网络名称', trigger: 'change' }]">
        <el-select v-model="container.networks" placeholder="请选择网络名称">
          <el-option
              v-for="network in networkList"
              :key="network"
              :label="network"
              :value="network"
          />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button @click="dialogVisible = false">取 消</el-button>
      <el-button type="primary" @click="submitAdd">确 定</el-button>
    </template>
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ElDialog, ElForm, ElFormItem, ElInput, ElSelect, ElOption, ElButton } from 'element-plus'
import { networkList } from '@/utils/network.js'
import { ref, defineExpose } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';

// 弹出框显示状态
const dialogVisible = ref(false);

// 打开弹出框
const openDialog = () => {
  dialogVisible.value = true;
};

// 容器数据
const container = ref({
  image: '',
  name: '',
  networks: []
});

// 提交容器数据
const submitAdd = async () => {
  try {
    console.log('Container created successfully');
    await axios.post('http://localhost:8081/container/create', container.value);
    dialogVisible.value = false;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error creating container:', error.response || error);
    alert('Error: ' + (error.response ? error.response.data : error.message));
  }
};

defineExpose({ openDialog })

</script>

<style scoped>
.container-form {
  padding-top: 10px;
}
</style>
